source: NASA MERRA-2 (GMAO) monthly mean 2 m air temperature (M2TMNXSLV T2M) and bias-corrected total precipitation (M2TMNXFLX PRECTOTCORR) for January–December 2023, as rendered by NASA GIBS (MERRA2_2m_Air_Temperature_Monthly, MERRA2_Precipitation_Bias_Corrected_Monthly) and decoded with the GIBS colormaps (1 K / fine precipitation bins). Averaged per region by scripts/build-geography.ts.
licence: NASA MERRA-2 and GIBS imagery: public domain (NASA).
notes: tempC = monthly mean 2 m temperature (°C), precipMm = monthly precipitation (mm). Derived indices in 0..1 per month: winter = clamp(−tempC / 15) (1 at −15 °C), monsoon = clamp((precipMm − 150) / 250) (1 at 400 mm/month), heat = clamp((tempC − 30) / 10) (1 at 40 °C). A single year (2023) stands in for the climatology; month-to-month patterns (monsoon timing, continental winters) are what the game uses.
